method.name: check_for_updates
method.description: Checks GitHub for the latest release of the plugin and compares it to the current version.

method.name: _on_request_completed
method.description: Callback for when the HTTP request is completed. Parses the response and checks if an update is available.

method.name: _get_current_version
method.description: Get the current version of the plugin from plugin.cfg, stripping any build metadata (e.g. "1.0.0+docs" → "1.0.0").

members.member: The HTTPRequest node used to make the API request. Stored as a member variable to keep it alive during the request.

signal.name: update_check_completed
signal.description: Emitted when the update check is completed, regardless of the result, allowing the update checker to be freed after the check is done.

constants.constant: The path for the plugin.cfg file, used to get the current version of the plugin.
The GitHub API URL to check for the latest release of the plugin.
The URL for the latest release page, used in the update message if a new version is available.

constant.name: SILENCE_HINT
constant.value: "(Note that the asset library version may lag behind the GitHub releases. You can disable this check in the plugin settings if you don\'t want to see this message again.)"

constants.constant: A hint to the user that they can disable the update check if they don't want to see the message again.
